files..work/inventory/spec.md:
# Search and export

**Status:** draft

Name search is accepted: return Unicode case-insensitive substring matches in input order. An empty query returns all items; no match or empty input returns [].

The export design is in [the existing decision record](decisions/01-export.md). CSV uses name,quantity headings, standard CSV quoting and LF endings. File export remains under discussion because existing-destination behavior is unanswered. No export implementation is ready.

**Blocked by:** none

Implement the accepted name-search behavior in the [accepted specification](../spec.md). Acceptance covers mixed-case matching, input order, empty queries, missing matches, and empty input. Project checks: checks/check_search.py.
